definitions.ask: How should a Record Card choice row that already has a value show it?
definitions.why: It matches other set rows, update rows, and the committed record summary

choices.label: Only Bob's display string, like other set rows; unset choice rows keep capsules
All choice capsules stay, with the set one emphasized; long choice lists stay wide

definitions.ask: Also fix the editor route emoji so it cleanly replaces the @ instead of sitting on top of it?
definitions.why: Same screenshot and feature; small and self-contained

choices.label: The @ glyph hides under an emoji fitted to one cell; draft bytes and offsets unchanged
The overlay stays as is and a small bug task bead records the root cause
